evidence.exact_span: There are difficulties in adopting this construction. In truth it covers a number of matters closely related to issues of judicial independence. stritates to particular work. Arrangements of that kind are not merely matters of internal administration.
The same may be said of the capacity to exercise that function free from the threat of civil or criminal sanctions.

The Tribunal has considered the nature of the documents relevant to Ms Bienstein's request, and finds that the documents refer to organisational matters such as Court lists and the assigning of judicial officers to particular cases.
